newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-WALES RECALL BATEMAN FOR FRANCE MATCH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WALES RECALL BATEMAN FOR FRANCE MATCH.

text.p: Nine days after undergoing surgery on an injured knee, centre Allan Bateman was named on Thursday in the Wales' side to play France in the Five Nations championship match in Paris on February 15.

Bateman, who played in the opening game against Scotland at Murrayfield, suffered knee ligament damage while playing for his club Richmond against Bedford and was forced to miss the defeat by Ireland in Cardiff on Saturday.
His return is the only change to the side who lost by one point. Bateman takes over at outside centre from Gareth Thomas who moves back to left-wing in place of Dafydd James.

Wales - Neil Jenkins; Ieuan Evans, Allan Bateman, Scott Gibbs, Gareth Thomas; Arwel Thomas, Robert Howley; Scott Quinnell, Colin Charvis, Steve Williams, Mark Rowley, Gareth Llewellyn, David Young,Jonathan Humphreys (captain), Christian Loader.
